clauses.clause: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
clauses.evidence: 'target slot (cast): 0..2 of [you_bear, you_giant, opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant]'. One target (any creature, either side): exactly one PLUS_1_PLUS_1 on it. [cast targets=['you_bear', 'you_giant']]: one counter on each. [cast] with no target: no counters. Cost {2}{W}{W} (W-4), sorcery. Canonical B5b-put-counter.

clauses.clause: You may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Basri, Devoted Paladin, reveal it, and put it into your hand.
clauses.evidence: Trace shows the optional ('ask may: [fire, skip]') but no Basri, Devoted Paladin on the board. Packs: basris_aegis_finds_basri_in_library (fire: Basri library -> hand, 7 cards remain) PASS; basris_aegis_finds_basri_in_graveyard (fire: graveyard -> hand) PASS; basris_aegis_decline_search_no_shuffle (skip: Basri stays in the library, the counter still lands) PASS.
clauses.issue: SEARCH uses ONE_OF (exactly one) where the compiler's B4-tutor-basri uses CHOOSE (up to one, CR 701.19b fail-to-find); inside an optional search this only removes an option. Same convention as this wave's Liliana's Scorn packet.

clauses.clause: If you search your library this way, shuffle.
clauses.evidence: SHUFFLE(your library) is inside the optional search. Pack basris_aegis_decline_search_no_shuffle PASS: without a search the library order is exactly unchanged. A shuffled order cannot be asserted from the text; the same SHUFFLE shape reorders the library on a search (Liliana's Scorn control, this wave).
clauses.issue: Searching always covers both zones, so 'graveyard only, no shuffle' is not available: weaker only.
